title: HtmlPreview
description: Previews untrusted HTML such as email templates in a fully sandboxed iframe. The markup is sanitized with DOMPurify (fail-closed) and rendered behind a Content-Security-Policy that blocks scripts and network access.

props.name: html
props.description: Untrusted HTML to preview (sanitized with DOMPurify in the browser)

props.name: viewport
props.description: Full-width desktop preview or a fixed-width mobile preview

props.name: mobileWidth
props.description: Width of the mobile preview in pixels (invalid values fall back to 375)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the iframe in pixels (invalid values fall back to 600)

translationResources.title: HtmlPreview
translationResources.description: Previews untrusted HTML such as email templates in a fully sandboxed iframe. The markup is sanitized with DOMPurify (fail-closed) and rendered behind a Content-Security-Policy that blocks scripts and network access.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Inline styles and data: images are kept; scripts, forms, links and remote images are removed.

viewports.title: Viewports
viewports.description: viewport="mobile" renders a fixed-width preview (mobileWidth); desktop fills the container.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The html attribute is sanitized and rendered in a sandboxed iframe; label gives the frame its accessible title.

viewport.title: Desktop and mobile
viewport.description: viewport="mobile" renders a fixed-width frame of mobile-width pixels; the markup is set through the html property.

sanitized.title: Untrusted input
sanitized.description: Edit the source: scripts and event handlers are removed and nothing runs, inline styles are kept.

props.label: Accessible title of the iframe (the React library's title; falls back to aria-label).

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: Interact with the native component in this phone preview.

native.limitations: This documentation uses a sandboxed iframe host. iOS and Android require the react-native-webview adapter shown in the Expo example; scripts and external navigation remain disabled.
